description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Axis_Category', which handles category axes in a graph plotting library. It includes methods for managing labels, sizes, dataset application, and rendering of category axes.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Category
classes.description: Handles category axes, managing labels and size calculations, and rendering specific to category-type axes.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Category
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the category axis, sets default labels, and label interval.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the axis, always 0.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the axis, based on the number of labels.

methods.name: _setMinimum
methods.description: Disabled for this axis type; does nothing.

methods.name: _setMaximum
methods.description: Disabled for this axis type; does nothing.

methods.name: forceMinimum
methods.description: A method placeholder that does not set minimum for this axis type.

methods.name: forceMaximum
methods.description: A method placeholder that does not set maximum for this axis type.

methods.name: setLabelInterval
methods.description: Sets label interval, with handling for auto and array inputs.

methods.name: _value
methods.description: Preprocesses value for logarithmic axes, returning label value if found.

methods.name: _minorLabelInterval
methods.description: Returns false; minor label intervals are disabled for category axes.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Calculates and returns the pixel size of the axis, including labels and title.

methods.name: _applyDataset
methods.description: Processes dataset to determine category label order and updates labels accordingly.

methods.name: _getNextLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the next label point for rendering.

methods.name: _isNumeric
methods.description: Returns false; category axes are non-numeric.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the axis rendering, including axis lines and tick labels.
